remarks: Exquisite New Construction - A Masterpiece of Style & Craftsmanship: Welcome to a stunningly designed new construction home where every detail has been thoughtfully curated for modern luxury and timeless elegance. Built in 2025 with superior craftsmanship and high-end finishes, this 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath residence is a testament to quality, sophistication, and functionality. Step inside to soaring ceilings, designer lighting, and a seamless blend of rich textures and contemporary hues that create an inviting yet refined ambiance. The open-concept main level is drenched in natural light, showcasing luxurious flooring, custom millwork, and impeccable attention to detail. The primary suite is nothing short of spectacular, offering a spa-inspired ensuite bath, walk-in closet, and private retreat-like ambiance. A main-level bedroom adds convenience and versatility, while a dedicated office space is perfect for remote work. The finished third floor is an incredible bonus space-ideal for a recreation room and/or additional flex space to suit your lifestyle needs. Outside, a rear patio extends your living space, creating the perfect setting for outdoor gatherings, while the low-maintenance yard and detached garage complete this exceptional home. Combining impeccable craftsmanship, sophisticated design, and an unbeatable floor plan, this home is truly one-of-a-kind. Don't miss your chance to own this newly built gem-schedule your private tour today!
